definitions.action_trace_equal: same number and ordered IDs of actually executed actions
definitions.action_match_denominator: steps at which both compared stages executed an action; extra actions excluded
definitions.shared_prefix: consecutive same action IDs from step 1 until the first mismatch, divided by comparable executed steps; aggregate ratio pools numerator and denominator across worlds
definitions.percentage_denominator: completed paired worlds for episode counts; comparable steps for action-ID matches; worlds within the named action-trace category for grouped stop order
definitions.stop_step: number of actually executed actions before singleton or certified equivalence
definitions.grouped_stop_delta: second-stage stop step minus first-stage stop step; positive means the first stage stopped earlier; absolute delta avoids cancellation
definitions.final_u_equality: exact equality of final survivor counts, equivalent to equality of log2 survivor counts; subgroup stop percentages use subgroup worlds
definitions.mean_terminal_u_and_c: computed separately across worlds; mean U is not log2(mean C)
